findings.source_quote: Take from Him power on earth to tread, / On serpent’s sting, on dragon’s head.
findings.suggested_fix: Pokea kutoka kwake uwezo wa kukanyaga mwiba wa nyoka na kichwa cha joka.
findings.translation_quote: Pokea kutoka kwake nguvu ya kukanyaga duniani, / Mwiba wa nyoka, kichwa cha joka.
